dosje.gov.in · hero banner shortlist · 5 Oct 2026

Hidden layers removed

Five of the ten banners carried a second photograph underneath, completely hidden by the one on top. All five are gone. Every banner now has exactly one image layer, and the picture is unchanged in each case — confirmed by comparing the frame before and after, pixel for pixel.

What was checked before deleting

For each frame, the layer being kept had to be the topmost one, fully visible, fully opaque, square-cornered, unrotated, carrying a single opaque image fill, and large enough to cover the whole frame — with the frame clipping its contents. Anything failing one of those was to be left alone. None did; all five passed.

The five kept layers keep their original size and position deliberately. Four of them are larger than the frame and sit partly outside it, which is how their crop is set. Resizing them to fit the frame exactly would re-fit the image and change which part of the photograph shows, so they were left as they are. The frames clip, so nothing spills into the PDF.

Nothing else was touched. The names, the PDF export settings, the board and the original Carousel frame elsewhere in the file are all as they were.
